name: Sky Beta — Stanford DroneHacks 2026
status: CAD geometry; uncalibrated mass and propulsion estimates

motor.name: DYS X2807 1500KV
motor.provenance: Motor identity official; all dynamic coefficients provisional, require thrust-stand/RPM or flight-log fitting. KV is not a thrust coefficient.

propeller.provenance: Assumed 7-inch propeller; not included in supplied CAD or specified on official page. Confirm before clearance claims.

mass_provenance: Engineering estimates, not measured weights. Frame and standoffs use CAD solid volumes and assumed densities. Electronics use lumped masses and uniform bounding-box inertia. Wiring/fasteners/rangefinder lumped at body origin.

camera.provenance: Nominal ideal stereo proxy, 75 mm baseline and 80 degree HFOV; lens centres inferred from camera enclosure, not calibrated optical extrinsics.
